transactions.notes: CROSS-YEAR DUPLICATE of the row in TS0U_FY2024.json -- deal_id 'ts0u:lippo_plaza_shanghai:divestment:2024' is IDENTICAL across both files (same deal, completed Dec 2024, year the deal completed used in the deal_id per spec rule), and all five required-field values (gain_loss_pct, pct_unit, pct_source, reference_value, reference_currency, reference_basis) are IDENTICAL to the FY2024 file for consistency. This deal appears in the FY2025 AR ONLY as an audit-trail/comparative reference explaining the FY2025 YoY revenue/NPI decline ('the absence of revenue contributions from Lippo Plaza Shanghai', p809; 'like-for-like revenue and NPI increased by 0.1% and 1.6% YoY respectively' excluding Lippo Plaza, p809/1618) -- it is NOT a new or second transaction, and this row should be deduplicated against the FY2024 row when the two files are merged/loaded, not double-counted. PROPERTY-LEVEL economics: gross sale consideration S$357,382,000 vs the disposed entity's investment-property carrying value S$311,136,000 (Note 30, FY2024 AR p181) = DERIVED +14.86% premium. The consolidated Statements of Total Return instead recorded a LOSS on disposal of the subsidiary of S$(26,427,000) for FY2024 -- this accounting loss has the OPPOSITE SIGN from the property-level economics above because it additionally nets in a S$54,614,000 recycled foreign-currency-translation-reserve (FCTR) and a S$32,323,000 disposal tax expense at the SPV/subsidiary-disposal level, neither of which reflects the property's price-vs-book performance. See TS0U_FY2024.json for the full breakdown and citations of this reconciliation (Note 30, p181 of the FY2024 AR).
